label: Heavy going
summary: The Gulf war widened and reached civilians. Iran said a US strike hit a wedding party in Sirik, killing five including a child and wounding 63; Washington said it was hitting IRGC air defences and mine-laying assets after attacks on Hormuz shipping. The Revolutionary Guards then fired on bases in Jordan, Bahrain and Iraq. Russia's barrage of Kyiv ran into a sixth day, killing twelve including six rail workers, and Germany accused Moscow of hybrid attacks after a drone incident at Leipzig airport. Eurozone inflation hit a three-year high of 3.3% on energy costs, making an ECB hike likely. The Himalayan flood toll held above 1,000 with thousands missing, and Borneo choked on its worst haze in a decade. Against that: Uganda was declared Ebola-free, London's Ulez was linked to better lung growth in children, and a nightly pill cut sleep-apnoea events by 44%.
